mods.name: Free Model Rotation
mods.description: Removes the 22.5-degree increment and single-axis limits on item/block model element rotation, and adds multi-axis (x/y/z) rotation. Backports the arbitrary Blockbench rotation format (vanilla snapshot 25w46a / 1.21.11+) to older versions. Client-side, drop-in: install it and your resource-pack models with free angles render correctly. Note: models with free angles only render correctly for players who have this mod installed.
